description: The single script-quality gate for the illustrated-story pipeline (RFC 0008), replacing the six-node comprehension/entertainment/factual-fidelity chain (script_quality_critic + reviser + critic + release, plus emotional_entertainment_editor) that pipeline used. Scores only what decides whether a viewer keeps watching: hook, suspense, watchability, entertainment, payoff, and fit for the platform. No factual_fidelity, no comprehension, no dialogue_naturalness, no character_chemistry -- those measured technical correctness on a two-host explainer format this pipeline no longer produces.

hook.description: Does the first line create a real question a viewer wants answered in the next few seconds?

suspense.description: Does tension escalate through the middle rather than staying flat or resolving early?

watchability.description: Read purely as spoken narration with no visuals: does it hold attention beat to beat?

entertainment.description: Wit, surprise, specificity, a real point of view -- not generic explainer tone.

payoff.description: Does the ending land -- earns the setup, isn't a flat summary or moral-of-the-story restatement?

youtube_fit.description: Titleable, thumbnailable, shareable -- the kind of premise that gets a click and a finish.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what would make a viewer click away, and where.
